extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x)=x^n, then f'(x)=nx^(n-1) for any real n.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If c is constant and f is differentiable, then d/dx[cf(x)]=cf'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Measures rate of change of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Real exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exponent n can be any real number in x^n.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Exponential Function e^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exponential function e^x whose derivative is itself.

extracted_concepts.name: General Exponential Function a^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exponential function with base a, derivative a^x ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural logarithm ln a
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Logarithm base e appearing in derivative of a^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Number e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Unique number such that lim_{h->0}(e^h-1)/h=1.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit definition of e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: lim_{h->0} (e^h-1)/h = 1 defining e.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose derivative exists.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A fixed real number c.

extracted_concepts.name: Position function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function s(t) giving position over time.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of position: v(t)=s'(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of velocity: a(t)=v'(t)=s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: MC = C'(x), derivative of cost.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative interpreted as a rate of change.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent line approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of finding derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Inverse operation of differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process connected to differentiation by the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and integration as inverse operations.

extracted_relations.evidence: Power Rule is a basic differentiation rule.
Rule extends to any real exponent, not just positive integers.
Constant multiple rule is a differentiation rule.
Rule requires a constant c.
Rule applies when f is differentiable.
Sum rule is a differentiation rule.
Rule applies if f and g are differentiable.
Difference rule is a differentiation rule.
Rule applies if f and g are differentiable.
Derivative exists only for a differentiable function.
d/dx(e^x)=e^x.
d/dx(a^x)=a^x ln a.
Derivative formula d/dx(a^x)=a^x ln a.
e is defined as the unique number with lim_{h->0}(e^h-1)/h=1.
Limit definition makes e^x its own derivative.
Velocity is derivative of position: v(t)=s'(t).
Acceleration is derivative of velocity: a(t)=v'(t).
Marginal cost is MC=C'(x).
Uses derivative to estimate function values near a known point.
Derivative interpreted as a rate of change.
Differentiation is inverse operation of antidifferentiation.
Text equates antidifferentiation with integration.
Fundamental Theorem of Calculus connects integration and differentiation.
